title: Hearty Irish Grill Grill
description: A comforting and flavorful Irish dish featuring a jammy filling, gooey cheese, and a hint of fines herbes. Serve with a side of coleslaw or pickles for added crunch.
instructions: Season lamb shoulder with salt, pepper, and thyme.
Sear lamb in a hot skillet until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer lamb to a baking dish and add diced onion, lamb fat or oil, and pickling spice.
Cover dish with foil and bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until lamb is tender.
While lamb cooks, mix together fines herbes, sour cream, and cheddar cheese in a bowl.
After 2 hours, remove lamb from oven and top with herby cheese mixture.
Return lamb to oven and bake for an additional 30 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from oven and let rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve with a side of coleslaw or pickles for added crunch.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
